name: Francis
source:
"All I can do is watch over you at all times."

Yvet's husband. 
At first, he looks at Yvet coldly when her father, Yeung Kwun, asks him to stay at his home, but he is impressed by her policy of using poison to control poison, and he begins to work hard to save her life.
He was a lawyer by profession, but after the death of his father, the head of the Red Flower Society, he took Yvet as his wife and became the head of the Red Flower Society in order to settle the turmoil of the succession battle.
He is a devoted husband and a passionate man.
When he is attacked, the Red Flower Society began to fall into chaos.
